component.name: /dev/raid
component.summary: Orchestrate many AI coding agents in persistent terminals
Orquestre vários agentes de IA em terminais persistentes

description.p: /dev/raid runs Claude Code, Codex, Aider and other AI coding agents side by side: one persistent terminal workspace per project, powered by tmux, that keeps running when you close the window.
Each agent can work in its own git worktree, you review the diff before accepting, and everything is keyboard driven.
O /dev/raid roda Claude Code, Codex, Aider e outros agentes lado a lado: um conjunto de terminais persistentes por projeto, com tmux, que continua vivo quando você fecha a janela.
